title: Make shelf navigation and cursor targets predictable
acceptance:
**Story or goal** · Move to one intended target at a time and find it again after Back.

**Expected behaviour** · Scope arrows to the shelf. Restore focus and scroll. Target Cursor frames the actionable widget or distinct icon button. Latest deliberate input selects pointer or focus targeting.

**Scope boundary** · Keep native keyboard focus and touch controls usable with the effect off.

**Previous in delivery queue** · WI-029

**Depends on** · WI-024, WI-029

**Verify** · Replay row edges, nested icons, separate buttons, keyboard/mouse handoff, a removed target and reduced motion.

**Effort basis** · Timing and geometry across input modes.
